title: Current LibreDWG PERSUBENTMGR source and issue status screen
scope: Check current LibreDWG source and issue #1398 for a source-distinct, validated PERSUBENTMGR body map or semantic model. Keep this class separate from ASSOCPERSSUBENTMANAGER.

localCheckout.head: 6d6a33987a1a97095b069c799c3d8a793320f812
observations: src/dwg2.spec proposes class_version, unknown_0, unknown_2, numassocsteps, numassocsubents, num_steps and a BL steps vector, then num_subents and a BL subents vector.
The same block says coverage is limited and comments that the subentity record is not represented by the simple vector: 'nope: 3x BL and CALL_SUBENT'.
The local TODO classifies PERSUBENTMGR under fields specified but broken/untested.

currentUpstreamScreen.revision: Mutable master reference; the browser response did not expose a commit SHA.
observations: The current upstream spec retains the same tentative BL/vector mapping and its limited-coverage and unresolved-subentity comments.
The current upstream manual lists PERSUBENTMGR in its Halfway category, not as complete support.
The issue author states that the observed 2,0,2,0,0,0 sequence does not establish the final num_subents location and lists multiple possible field assignments.
The Nov 16 proposed record/history structure is presented as an idea, without a matching producer/API-state witness or validated body spans.
The Aug 17 merged PR was clarified by the author as fixing the distinct ASSOCPERSSUBENTMANAGER class, not PERSUBENTMGR.

decision: Current LibreDWG master is useful as a source-distinct candidate map, but its own code comments and documentation mark PERSUBENTMGR incomplete, and issue #1398 remains open. Neither the vector interpretation nor the newer record/history proposal is independent proof of physical DWG field spans or selected-member semantics. Keep libdxfrw's current bounded Partial/raw behavior and strict-output refusal.
next: Do not implement the current peer mapping or issue proposal. Continue P6-B only when full AutoCAD/ObjectARX can establish exact AcDbPersSubentManager creation, owner, a selected nonzero path, and persistence after reopen; then bind the body spans and handle roles against ODA v5.4.1 and a source-bound independent decode.
